accuracyNotice: Service details (fees, processing times, requirements, and offices) have been verified against the official LGU Agoo, La Union Citizen's Charter as of March 2023. Some ancillary fees (e.g., barangay clearance, police clearance) are collected by external offices and may vary. Always confirm with the responsible office before transacting.

services.title: Birth Certificate
services.description: Get a certified transcript copy of a birth certificate registered in Agoo, or request PSA-issued copies via the BREQS system
services.fee: ₱80 (local) — ₱50 transcript + ₱30 DST; BREQS: ₱60 service fee + ₱155 (Birth/Marriage/Death) or ₱210 (CENOMAR)

services.title: Marriage Certificate
services.description: Register a marriage or request a certified true copy of the marriage certificate from the Civil Registry Office
services.fee: Free (timely registration); ₱80 certified copy (₱50 transcript + ₱30 DST); Delayed registration: ₱10/copy + ₱30 DST

services.title: Death Certificate
services.description: Register a death certificate and obtain burial or transfer permit; delayed registration available
services.fee: Free (timely registration); Delayed registration: ₱10/certified xerox copy + ₱30 DST; Certified copy: ₱50 + ₱30 DST

services.title: Marriage License Application
services.description: Apply for a marriage license at the Civil Registry Office; valid for 120 days anywhere in the Philippines. Application is posted for 10 days before release.
services.processingTime: 40 minutes (application processing); license released after 10-day posting period

services.title: Barangay Clearance
services.description: Certificate of residence from your barangay

services.title: Barangay ID
services.description: Official barangay identification card

services.title: Police Clearance
services.description: Police clearance from the Agoo Police Station (required for Mayor's Clearance and various permits)

services.title: Mayor's Clearance
services.description: Mayor's Clearance for employment, license applications, overseas travel, and other purposes. Certifies residency, good moral character, and law-abiding status.
requirements: 1 copy Community Tax Certificate (from Municipal Treasurer's Office)
1 copy Official Receipt (from Municipal Treasurer's Office)
1 copy Police Clearance (from Agoo Police Station)

services.title: Business Permit (New)
services.description: Apply for a new Mayor's Permit to operate a business in Agoo. Fees are based on the Agoo Revenue Code of 2013.
services.fee: Varies per Agoo Revenue Code of 2013 (Gross Sales Tax + Sanitary Permit + Mayor's Permit + Tax Clearance + Signage + Garbage + Fire Safety + Sanitary Inspection + Health Examination + Business Plate)
requirements: DTI Registration (Sole Proprietor) / SEC Registration (Corporation) / CDA Registration (Cooperative) — 1 original & 1 xerox
Contract of Lease if place of business is rented — 1 original & 1 xerox
Capital Investment document (costs of land, building, machinery) — 1 photocopy
Other documents as may be necessary

services.title: Business Permit Renewal
services.description: Renew your annual business permit. Renewal period is the whole month of January; 25% surcharge + 2% monthly interest (max 72%) imposed starting February.
services.fee: Varies per Agoo Revenue Code of 2013; 25% surcharge + 2%/month interest if filed after January
requirements: Audited/Sworn Statement of Gross Sales/Receipts — 1 original copy
Clearances from SSS, PhilHealth, HDMF, FDA, BAI (for businesses on their negative list) — 1 original & 1 xerox
Other documents as may be necessary

services.title: Business Closure / Retirement
services.description: File for business closure/retirement from business; obtain a Business Closure Certification for clearing other agencies
services.fee: Business Tax upon assessment from submitted gross sales; Closure Certification: ₱80 (₱50 certification + ₱30 DST)
requirements: Latest Mayor's Permit — 1 original copy
Barangay Certification from business location — 1 original copy
Lessor's Certification — 1 original copy
Audited/Sworn Gross Sales/Receipts — 1 photocopy

services.title: Working Permit
services.description: Working permit for employees working within the Municipality of Agoo
services.fee: ₱30 DST + ₱140 Health Examination + ₱30 Police Clearance + Occupation Fee (variable) + Community Tax Certificate
requirements: Filled-up bill form — 1 copy (from BPLD)
Barangay clearance — 1 copy

services.title: Motorized Tricycle Operator's Permit (MTOP)
services.description: Franchise/license for tricycle-for-hire operators in Agoo. Annual renewal in January; penalty starts February.
services.fee: ₱1,440 total (Mayor's Permit ₱450 + Annual Renewal ₱100 + Annual Supervision ₱50 + Verification ₱50 + Tax Clearance ₱50 + Garbage ₱200 + Health Exam ₱140 + Drug Testing ₱250 + Business Plate ₱150); Franchise Renewal every 3 years: ₱500; Body Number Painting: ₱200
requirements: MTOP Franchise — 1 original & 1 xerox
Clearance from ATMO (roadworthiness)
Clearance from VMO/SBO (franchise verification)
Clearance from MTO (tax clearance)

services.title: Tricycle Special Permit
services.description: Special permit for non-Agoo resident tricycle operators from neighboring LGUs
services.fee: ₱1,340 total (Mayor's Permit ₱450 + Annual Supervision ₱50 + Verification ₱50 + Tax Clearance ₱50 + Garbage ₱200 + Health Exam ₱140 + Drug Testing ₱250 + Business Plate ₱150); Body Number Painting ₱200

services.title: Motorized Banca Permit
services.description: Annual permit for motorized banca owners in Agoo. Renewal every January; penalty starts February.
services.fee: ₱400 total (Mayor's Permit ₱200 + Tax Clearance ₱50 + Business Plate ₱150); Registration Fee every 3 years ₱75; License Fee every 3 years ₱100; Inspection Fee every 3 years ₱25; CTC ₱55; Barangay Clearance ₱50; Police Clearance ₱50; Documentary Stamp Tax (variable)
services.office: Business Permit and Licensing Division / Municipal Agriculture Office

services.title: Van Transport Permit
services.description: Annual van transport permit for qualified ABVT Group members. Renewal every January.
services.fee: ₱1,265 total (Mayor's Permit ₱500 + Annual Supervision ₱50 + Verification ₱50 + Tax Clearance ₱50 + Garbage ₱200 + Health Exam ₱140 + License Fee ₱25 + Registration ₱100 + Business Sticker ₱150)

services.title: Cemetery Fees
services.description: Cemetery fees collected before registration of death certificate and interment at the Agoo Municipal Cemetery
services.fee: Burial Chamber: Resident ₱7,250 / Non-resident ₱12,300; Ossuary Niche: from Old Cemetery ₱5,450 / from Other Cemeteries ₱10,100; Repository Niche: Resident ₱4,400 / Non-resident ₱9,450

services.title: Sanitary Permit & Health Certificate (Business)
services.description: Sanitary permit and health certificate for business establishments, issued by the Municipal Health Office
services.fee: Varies (included in business permit fees per Agoo Revenue Code of 2013)

services.title: Community Tax Certificate (Cedula)
services.description: Obtain cedula (CTC) for individuals and businesses. 24% annual interest for late payment.
services.fee: Individual: ₱5 basic + ₱1 per ₱1,000 gross income; Juridical Person: ₱500 basic + ₱2 per ₱5,000 gross income
services.office: Municipal Treasurer's Office (Other Taxes and Fees Division)

services.title: Senior Citizen ID
services.description: ID card and benefits for citizens 60 years and above; issued by MSWDO / OSCA

services.title: PWD ID & Services
services.description: ID and benefits for persons with disabilities

services.title: Financial Assistance (AICS)
services.description: Emergency financial aid for individuals and families in crisis situations, coordinated through MSWDO

services.title: Burial Assistance
services.description: Financial assistance for burial expenses; coordinate referrals through MSWDO

services.title: Solo Parent ID
services.description: ID and benefits for solo parents under RA 8972

services.title: Pre-Marriage Orientation & Counseling
services.description: Mandatory pre-marriage orientation and counseling for couples applying for marriage license

services.title: VAWC Assistance
services.description: Assistance to victims of Violence Against Women and their Children (VAWC) under RA 9262

services.title: Children in Conflict with the Law (CICL) Assistance
services.description: Social services and diversion programs for children in conflict with the law under RA 9344

services.title: Vaccination Programs
services.description: Free immunization for children and adults including anti-rabies vaccination

services.title: Health Certificate
services.description: Medical/health certificate for employment or business establishments
services.fee: ₱140 (Service Fee for Health Examination, per Agoo Revenue Code)

services.title: Medical Assistance / General Consultation
services.description: Free general consultation and medical check-up at the Municipal Health Office; referrals to hospitals for indigent patients

services.title: Pre-natal / Post-natal Check-up
services.description: Free prenatal and post-natal care for pregnant and post-partum women at the Municipal Health Office

services.title: Animal Bite Services
services.description: Animal bite treatment and anti-rabies services at the Municipal Health Office

services.title: Drug Rehabilitation Services
services.description: Primary care and aftercare programs for drug dependents through the Municipal Drug Rehabilitation Program
services.office: Municipal Health Office / Drug Rehabilitation Unit

services.title: Real Property Tax Payment
services.description: Pay annual real property tax (amilyar) — 1% basic tax + 1% SEF on assessed value of land, building, machinery and other improvements
services.fee: Basic Tax: 1% of assessed value + SEF: 1% of assessed value
services.office: Municipal Treasurer's Office (Real Property Tax Division)
requirements: Latest Official Receipt (photocopy) OR
Real Property Tax Order of Payment from Assessor's Office

services.title: Real Property Tax Payment Certification
services.description: Certification of real property tax payment for legal intents and purposes
services.office: Municipal Treasurer's Office (Real Property Tax Division)

services.title: Business Tax Payment
services.description: Pay quarterly or annual business taxes per the Agoo Revenue Code of 2013
services.fee: Varies per Agoo Revenue Code of 2013

services.title: Professional Tax
services.description: Annual professional tax payment for licensed professionals
services.office: Municipal Treasurer's Office (Other Taxes and Fees Division)
requirements: 1 copy of Professional License (from PRC)

services.title: Tax Clearance
services.description: Certificate of no tax liability; required for business permits and other transactions
services.fee: ₱50 (Tax Clearance Fee per Agoo Revenue Code)

services.title: Rental Fee Payment
services.description: Payment of rental fees for stalls at LGU-Agoo Economic Enterprise

services.title: Agricultural Loans & Assistance
services.description: Low-interest loans and farm inputs for registered farmers

services.title: Crop Insurance
services.description: Insurance coverage for crop damage through PCIC

services.title: Fertilizer & Seeds Assistance
services.description: Free or subsidized fertilizer and palay seed distribution for registered farmers

services.title: Livestock & Veterinary Services
services.description: Stock treatment, large animal vaccination and deworming, anti-rabies vaccination for animals, artificial insemination, and stock dispersal

services.title: Fishery & Aquaculture Services
services.description: Tilapia fingerling dispersal (500 pcs below), motorized banca permit assistance, and community organizing for fisherfolk cooperatives
services.fee: Free (fingerling dispersal); Banca Permit: see Motorized Banca Permit entry

services.title: Building Permit
services.description: Permit required before constructing, altering, repairing, or demolishing any building or structure in Agoo
services.fee: Application Fee ₱150 + Building Inspection Fee ₱500 + Municipal Fire Inspection Fee (Residential: ₱100; Commercial/Institutional: ₱130) + other fees based on structure type
services.processingTime: Minimum 2 hours 30 minutes; Maximum 5 days (Simple Application)
requirements: Duly accomplished application forms (Building, Sanitary, Electrical & Mechanical) — 1 copy
Plans, Specifications & Cost Estimates — 5 copies each
Structural Design Analysis & Computation (for 2-storey & above) — 5 copies each
Soil Analysis/Boring Test (for 3-storey & above) — 3 copies xerox
Title, Tax Declaration, Deed of Sale or Deed of Donation (LOT) — 3 copies xerox
Current Tax Receipt — 3 copies xerox
Affidavit of Consent from Lot Owner (if lot not owned by applicant) — 3 copies xerox
Special Power of Attorney — 2 copies xerox
Municipal Zoning Compliance Certificate — 1 photocopy
Environmental Compliance Certificate from DENR (if necessary)
Highway Clearance from DPWH (if along National Highway)
Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance from BFP — 2 photocopies
DOLE Certificate — Construction Safety & Health Program — 2 photocopies

services.title: Certificate of Occupancy
services.description: Required before any building may be used or occupied; issued after final inspection by the Municipal Engineering Office
services.fee: Application Fee ₱150 + Final Inspection Fee ₱500 + other fees based on structure type
services.processingTime: Minimum 1 hour 30 minutes; Maximum 1 day (Simple Application)

services.title: Zoning Certificate & Locational Clearance
services.description: Certificate of Zoning Classification and Locational Clearance for conforming and non-conforming projects under Municipal Ordinance No. 22-2018
services.fee: Free (conforming projects); Variance/Exception: includes filing fee
services.processingTime: 1 hour 20 minutes (conforming); Up to 30 days deliberation (non-conforming variance)
services.office: Municipal Planning and Development Office (MPDO) / Zoning Office

services.title: Road Maintenance Request
services.description: Report road damage or request repairs through the Municipal Engineering Office

services.title: Scholarship Programs
services.description: Financial assistance for students; Mayor's Endorsement required for scholarship grant applications to line agencies

services.title: Student Assistance (SPES)
services.description: Special Program for the Employment of Students (SPES) — employment referral for students during vacation

services.title: Employment Facilitation Services
services.description: Employment referrals, jobs fair, and recruitment assistance for employers and job seekers through PESO

services.title: Emergency Response & Disaster Management
services.description: 24/7 emergency assistance, rescue operations, and disaster response management; includes relief operations, typhoon DRRM operations, and emergency medical services

services.title: Disaster Preparedness & Training
services.description: Training, drills, simulation exercises, seminars, and IEC materials for disaster awareness and preparedness through MDRRMO

services.title: CCTV Footage Request
services.description: Request for viewing and extraction of CCTV footage from the MDRRMO

services.title: Environmental Clearance
services.description: Environmental compliance certificate for projects (coordinated with DENR); required for building permits in applicable areas

services.title: Tree Cutting Permit
services.description: Permit to cut or trim trees

services.title: Nursery Seedlings Distribution
services.description: Free distribution of nursery seedlings for tree planting by the Municipal Agriculture Office

services.title: Agoo Slaughterhouse Services
services.description: Hog, cattle, goat, and carabao slaughter with meat inspection services

services.title: MSWDO Services
services.description: Social case studies, indigency certificates, AICS, PWD and senior citizen assistance, VAWC, CICL, and child development services

services.title: Waste Management Services
services.description: Garbage collection and disposal services (Service Charge for Garbage Collection included in business permit fees)
services.fee: ₱200 (Service Charge for Garbage Collection, included in business permit); residential included in taxes

services.title: Agoo Public Market Services
services.description: Market clearance, entrance fees, vendor services, sanitation monitoring, and market operations management

services.title: Business Permits & Licensing Office
services.description: New permits, renewals, Mayor's clearance, working permits, and other business permits under the Agoo Revenue Code of 2013
services.fee: Varies per Agoo Revenue Code of 2013

services.title: Tricycle Franchising & Records
services.description: Apply for tricycle franchise (MTOP), special permit, renewal, replacement of motor, and transfer of franchise under Agoo municipal ordinances
services.fee: MTOP: ₱1,440 (new); Renewal fee every 3 years: ₱500; Transfer/Replacement: varies per Ordinance No. 02-2011 / 01-2016

services.title: Municipal Treasurer's Office
services.description: Tax collection, cedula (CTC), RPT payment, professional tax, rental fees, and disbursement services

services.title: Municipal Budget Office
services.description: Obligation requests, barangay budget review, and annual budget preparation

services.title: Municipal Accounting Office
services.description: Pre-audit of disbursements, payroll processing, check issuance, remittances to GSIS/Pag-IBIG/BIR/PhilHealth/SSS, bank reconciliation, and financial reporting

services.title: Property Declaration
services.description: Declaration of land, building and machineries for tax assessment; includes transfer/revision of tax declaration and issuance of certified true copies
services.fee: Varies (free for assessment; certified copy fees apply)

services.title: Municipal Assessor's Office
services.description: Property assessment, tax declaration transfer/revision, certified copies of tax maps, and ocular inspection of real properties
services.fee: Varies per service (certified copies apply per ordinance)

services.title: Local Civil Registrar
services.description: Birth, marriage, death certificates, BREQS, delayed registration, supplemental reports, legitimation, and other civil registry services
services.fee: ₱80 (certified local copy); BREQS: ₱60 + document fee; Marriage License: Free; Delayed Registration: ₱10/copy + ₱30 DST

services.title: Municipal Engineering Office
services.description: Building permits, certificates of occupancy, and engineering services for construction in Agoo
services.fee: Application Fee ₱150; Building Inspection ₱500; Final Inspection ₱500; + other fees per structure type
services.processingTime: Minimum 2.5 hours (Building Permit); Minimum 1.5 hours (Occupancy); Simple applications up to 5 days

services.title: Municipal Planning & Development Office
services.description: Zoning classification certificates, locational clearances for conforming and non-conforming projects under Municipal Ordinance No. 22-2018
services.processingTime: 1 hour 20 minutes (conforming); Up to 30 days + 32 minutes (non-conforming)

services.title: Municipal Agriculture Office
services.description: Agricultural assistance: livestock services, stock dispersal, artificial insemination, palay seeds, tilapia fingerlings, nursery seedlings, cooperative organizing, and technology demonstrations

services.title: General Services Office
services.description: Property management, vehicle maintenance, and general municipal services

services.title: Human Resource Management Office
services.description: Employment, personnel records, leave applications, service records, travel authority, and HR services

services.title: Legislative Services (Sangguniang Bayan)
services.description: Certification of municipal ordinances and resolutions, tricycle franchise renewal/transfer, NGO/PO accreditation, barangay ordinance approval, administrative complaints, necrological services, PLEB clearance, and library services

services.title: Library & Computer Services
services.description: Traditional library, Bool library, computer library, Wi-Fi, and children's library services at the Sangguniang Bayan

services.title: Tourism Services
services.description: Directory assistance for LGU-Agoo offices, day tour requests, tourism data, and media/researcher information services
